# City Life Story - A GTA-Inspired Browser Game 🌆

Welcome to **City Life Story**, a browser-based game inspired by the Grand Theft Auto series! Built with vanilla JavaScript, this game brings the thrill of city exploration, missions, and interactive storylines directly to your web browser.

**[Play City Life Story](https://codexdevv.github.io/city-life-story/)**

## Overview

City Life Story is an immersive browser game that lets you:
- Explore a dynamic city environment
- Complete various missions and challenges
- Interact with in-game characters
- Experience a rich storyline
- Manage in-game resources and progression

Built entirely with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, this game demonstrates what can be achieved with pure frontend technologies without relying on game engines or frameworks.

## 🎮 Key Features

- **Dynamic City Environment**: Navigate through a living, breathing city
- **Mission System**: Engage with various missions and objectives
- **Character Interactions**: Meet and interact with diverse characters
- **Resource Management**: Track and manage in-game resources
- **Progression System**: Level up and unlock new content
- **Responsive Design**: Play across different devices and screen sizes

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Clone the repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/CodexDevv/city-life-story.git
```

2. Open `index.html` in your browser

That's it! No build tools, no dependencies, no server required.

```

├── index.html              # Entry point
├── css/                    # Stylesheets
│   ├── styles.css          # Main styles
│   ├── ui.css              # UI components

│   │   └── vehicle.js      # Vehicle entities
│   ├── systems/
│   │   ├── combat.js       # Combat system
│   │   ├── mission.js      # Mission system
│   │   ├── dialogs.js      # Dialog system
│   │   ├── notifications.js# Notification system
│   │   └── inventory.js    # Inventory system
│   └── ui/
```
